items.title: Show HN: Leia – a CLI to oneshot playlists onto Yoto MYO cards
items.contentSnippet:
Might be useful for anyone with a Yoto and eager kids.
Simple cli and agent skill to go from a audio/video playlist url (bulk loading) to a Yoto MYO card. Yt-dlp to download media and the yoto dev api to upload audio to your MYO account. Useful for loading whole seasons or series in one go.
Handles downloading, organising chapters, writing titles, dedupes, artwork/icons, and managing/fitting card limits. Runs locally. Works exactly where you're thinking.
